question: Why was the corn straw–oil sludge composite fuel made with 60% oil sludge?
rendered: The corn straw–oil sludge composite fuel was made with a mass ratio of 60% corn straw and 40% oil sludge, not 60% oil sludge. This ratio was fixed based on a previous study on pelletization.
